title: Reviewing F1 Contracts with Singapore Government and Strengthening Guidelines for Investment-oriented Agencies that Engage with Private Entities
what_it_is: Reviewing F1 Contracts with Singapore Government and Strengthening Guidelines for Investment-oriented Agencies that Engage with Private Entities

sections.label: F1 contract review
sections.summary: STB's F1 contract, renewed three times and ending in 2028, is being reviewed given corruption allegations, with an audit of the 2022 race.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: In 2007, STB entered into a contract with Singapore GP Pte Ltd to organise the F1 night race in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: STB renewed this contract three times, in 2012, 2017 and 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We are in the fourth term of our contract, which will end in 2028.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) had previously said that: “The terms of all the agreements were considered carefully by the Government.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: There is nothing to suggest as of now that either the F1 contracts or other contracts were structured to the disadvantage of the Government.” But as Members will appreciate, given the allegations of corruption, we are reviewing the terms of deal again.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We have also asked STB to conduct an audit of the most recent race, held in 2022, of which accounts are ready for audit.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Whilst we will review any Government contracts to safeguard Singapore’s interest, we remain committed to the F1 Singapore Grand Prix.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Like other Government agencies, our economic agencies abide by the Public Service Code of Conduct, which sets out the principles and rules of engagement.

sections.label: MTI leads review
sections.summary: MTI is leading the review and may involve other agencies in the process.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
